attempts.text:
**The window starts on a three-gene spine.** Columns 0 to 2, `gmk`, `ligB` and `yicG`, are carried by 92 to 100% of chromosomes, persistent, and in a region of plasticity in 0 to 2% of calls. The model names 93 to 99.8% of them, fewest at column 1, `ligB`, 93%, where it is also most hesitant, 0.47 bits.

**A variable column, then a long spine.** Column 3 is variable, in a region of plasticity in 15% of calls, named 81%. Columns 4 to 15, `yicC` to `waaA`, are persistent, 97 to 99% carried, in a region of plasticity in 13 to 16% of calls, named 81 to 92%; the model hesitates most at column 4, `yicC`, 0.82 bits.

**The first fork opens the `waa` stretch.** Column 16 is a fork, `rfaQ` at 76% beside a second `rfaQ` family at 21%. Columns 19 to 24 are fork columns, in a region of plasticity in 63 to 93% of calls, named 55 to 64%, most hesitant at column 19, 0.64 bits. A second branch of 5 families runs through columns 19 to 23, carried by 19% of chromosomes, all shell: `waaO` to `rfaL`, [[glycosyltransferase core assembly]].

**A persistent middle, then a fork and variable end.** Columns 25 to 42, `rfaC` to `lldP`, are persistent, 95 to 99% carried, named 53 to 97%. Columns 45 to 51, `yibL` to `yibH`, are persistent, named 85 to 95%. Column 52, `yibG`, is the most hesitant column of the window, 1.00 bits, in a region of plasticity in 17% of calls. Columns 56 to 79 are fork and variable columns, in a region of plasticity in 16 to 78% of calls, named 78 to 96%; a second branch of 4 persistent families, `xylA` to `yiaA`, runs through columns 76 to 79.

**Inside a region of plasticity the model hesitates more than outside**, 0.59 against 0.17 bits, and names fewer genes, 73% against 93%; 13,012 of the 43,198 calls are inside one. Across the window it names 87% of genes, 0.30 bits on average. The window ends at column 79, `xylG`, in 43% of chromosomes.

label: gmk
facts:
WINDOW: the gmk window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor gmk, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 60 to 139 from dnaA. Read in 540 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying gmk once); 43,198 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 87% of genes, 0.30 bits on average (perplexity 1.7 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 28,511 calls, named 96%, 0.12 bits; shell 14,099 calls, named 72%, 0.53 bits; cloud 588 calls, named 22%, 3.32 bits. Outside an RGP 30,186 calls, named 93%, 0.17 bits; inside an RGP 13,012 calls, named 73%, 0.59 bits. Columns: 45 spine, 19 fork, 16 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.59 against 0.17 bits) and names fewer genes (73% against 93%); 13,012 of the 43,198 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 52 (yibG) 1.00 bits, RGP 17%; column 4 (yicC) 0.82 bits, RGP 15%; column 53 (yibF) 0.76 bits, RGP 17%. The 22 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 79%, 0.31 bits on average; the other 58 columns: named 90%, 0.29 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 19-24 (fork), RGP 63-93%; the least: columns 0-2 (spine), RGP 0-2%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. columns 0-2 (3 columns) spine: share 92-100%, all P, RGP 0-2%. Genes: gmk, ligB, yicG "trimeric intracellular cation chann…". named 93-99.8% (mean 97%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 1 (ligB), named 93%, 0.47 bits.
2. column 3 variable: RGP 15%. named 81%; 0.62 bits.
   3: dinD S 78%
3. columns 4-15 (12 columns) spine: share 97-99%, all P, RGP 13-16%. Genes: yicC "YicC/YloC family endoribonuclease", rph, pyrE, slmA, dut, coaBC, radC, rpmB "50S ribosomal protein L28", rpmG, mutM, coaD, waaA. named 81-92% (mean 90%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 4 (yicC), named 81%, 0.82 bits.
4. column 16 fork: RGP 13%. named 80%; 0.33 bits.
   16: rfaQ S 76%; also rfaQ (another family) S 21%
5. columns 17-18 (2 columns) spine: share 98%, all P, RGP 13-30%. Genes: waaG, rfaP. named 90-92% (mean 91%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 18 (rfaP), named 90%, 0.41 bits.
6. columns 19-24 (6 columns) fork: RGP 63-93%. named 55-64% (mean 58%), fewest named at column 21, named 55%; most hesitant at column 19, 0.64 bits.
   a second branch of 5 families through columns 19-23, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 19%, all S; the branch's families: waaO, rfaY, waaR, waaD, rfaL
   19: waaO S 55%; also "glycosyltransferase" S 14%
   20: "glycosyltransferase family 8 protein" S 54%; also waaB S 24%
   21: rfaY S 55%; also waaO S 24%
   22: "glycosyltransferase family 8 C-terminal…" S 54%; also rfaJ S 24%
   23: "glycosyltransferase family 2 protein" S 36%; also rfaY S 24%, "hypothetical protein" S 19%
   24: "O-antigen ligase family protein" S 36%; also waaZ S 23%, "hypothetical protein" S 19%
7. columns 25-42 (18 columns) spine: share 95-99%, all P, RGP 3-32%. Genes: rfaC, rfaF, rfaD "ADP-glyceromanno-heptose 6-epimerase", kbl, tdh, waaH, yibQ "divergent polysaccharide deacetylas…", envC, gpmM, yibN "rhodanese-like domain-containing pr…", grxC, secB, gpsA, cysE, trmL, lldD "alpha-hydroxy-acid oxidizing protein", lldR, lldP. named 53-97% (mean 90%), fewest named at column 25 (rfaC), named 53%; most hesitant at column 30 (waaH), 0.23 bits.
8. columns 43-44 (2 columns) fork: RGP 9%. named 76%; most hesitant at column 43, 0.38 bits.
   43: "ESPR-type extended signal peptide-conta…" S 20%; also ehaG S 14%
   44: "hypothetical protein" S 26%; also "hypothetical protein" S 26%
9. columns 45-51 (7 columns) spine: share 96-98%, all P, RGP 6-17%. Genes: yibL "YibL family ribosome-associated pro…", yibT "protein YibT", mtlR "mannitol operon repressor MtlR", mtlD, mtlA, yibI "DUF3302 domain-containing protein", yibH "biotin/lipoyl-binding protein". named 85-95% (mean 91%), fewest named at column 45 (yibL), named 85%; most hesitant at column 51 (yibH), 0.69 bits.
10. column 52 variable: RGP 17%. named 82%; 1.00 bits.
   52: yibG S 54% "sel1 repeat family protein"
11. columns 53-55 (3 columns) spine: share 95-96%, all P, RGP 17-30%. Genes: yibF "glutathione S-transferase N-termina…", selA "L-seryl-tRNA(Sec) selenium transfer…", selB. named 84-90% (mean 87%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 53 (yibF), named 84%, 0.76 bits.
12. columns 56-79 (24 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 16-78%. named 78-96% (mean 89%), fewest named at column 60, named 78%; most hesitant at column 57, 0.48 bits.
   a second branch of 4 families through columns 76-79, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 18-25%, all P; the branch's families: xylA, xylB, yiaB, yiaA
   56 variable: yiaY S 86% "iron-containing alcohol dehydrogena…"
   57 fork: aldB P 88%; also "type II toxin-antitoxin system HicA fam…" S 11%
   58 fork: "type II toxin-antitoxin system HicB fam…" S 10%; also "hypothetical protein" S 10%
   59 variable: "hypothetical protein" S 52%
   60 variable: yiaV S 63%
   61 variable: atpI P 1%
   62 fork: yiaU S 59% "LysR family transcriptional regulat…"; also "IS1-like element transposase" S 23%
   63 fork: yiaT S 59% "MipA/OmpV family protein"; also "hypothetical protein" S 30%
   64 variable: araD S 71%
   65 variable: sgbU S 71%
   66 fork: ulaD S 71%; also "MFS transporter" S 31%
   67 fork: yiaO S 69% "TRAP transporter substrate-binding…"; also lyxK S 66%, "AraC family transcriptional regulator" S 31%
   columns 68-75 variable, share 60-78%, 5 S, 3 P: yiaN "2,3-diketo-L-gulonate TRAP transpor…" 68%, yiaM "2,3-diketo-L-gulonate TRAP transpor…" 60%, yiaL "YhcH/YjgK/YiaL family protein" 70%, yiaK "Ldh family oxidoreductase" 72%, yiaJ "IclR family transcriptional regulat…" 73%, ysaA "4Fe-4S dicluster domain-containing…" 78%, avtA 76%, malS 72%
   76 fork: bax P 69%
   77 fork: xylR P 61%
   78 fork: xylH P 53% "sugar ABC transporter permease"
   79 fork: xylG P 43%; also xylF P 31%, wecH P 14%
PRODUCTS of named genes (for [[ ]]): rpmG 50S ribosomal protein L33; rfaC glycosyltransferase family 9 protein; mtlD mannitol-1-phosphate 5-dehydrogenase; mtlA PTS mannitol transporter subunit IICBA; selB GTP-binding protein; xylR substrate-binding domain-containing pro…; xylH sugar ABC transporter permease; xylG ATP-binding cassette domain-containing…; rfaQ lipopolysaccharide core heptosyltransfe…; waaO glycosyltransferase; waaB glycosyltransferase; rfaY lipopolysaccharide core heptose(II) kin…; waaR glycosyltransferase family 8 C-terminal…; rfaJ glycosyltransferase family 8 C-terminal…; waaD glycosyltransferase; waaZ 3-deoxy-D-manno-oct-2-ulosonate III tra…; rfaL O-antigen ligase RfaL; yibB WlaTC/HtrL family glycosyltransferase; lyxK FGGY family carbohydrate kinase; xylA xylose isomerase; xylB FGGY family carbohydrate kinase; xylF D-xylose ABC transporter substrate-bind…; yiaA YiaA/YiaB family inner membrane protein; wecH O-acetyltransferase WecH
